identity: Speed and flow: many cheap cards, Gusts conjured into the hand, spells that grow with every card played this turn, and winds that carry Bianca's poisons and oils to every foe.
description: Chiara becomes the storm. She fills the hand with Gusts, chains cheap cards for Momentum and spreads Bianca's Poison and Oil across the whole enemy line.

starting_passive.name: Tailwind
starting_passive.description: The third card the party plays each turn (either princess's) adds a Gust to the hand. Once per turn. A Gust is a 0-cost card that deals 3 Wind damage and vanishes when played or at the end of the turn.

skill_tree.note: Add skill nodes as the specialization is implemented.
